rulings.ruling: Ruling: ambiguity; amb.2025.f7203_prorata_places (i7203 p. 4, Column (c): 'enter the pro rata amount on the corresponding line in column (c) ... can't exceed the amount reported on line 10', with no rounding rule): the project takes the chosen reading, the ratio line 10 / line 47(a) half-up to six places (0.333333), so with basis 10,000 and losses 20,000 and 10,000 column (c) totals 9,999.99 and a cent of basis and carryover moves; the model took the other reading (exact ratio, 6,666.67 + 3,333.33 = 10,000). One cent, within the ambiguity's stated bound; the same cent the transcription review raised and that log rules ambiguity.
